world.title: Is this Tom Rodriguez's baby mama?
world.description:
Since revealing in November 2024 that he had become a father to a baby boy named Korben, Tom Rodriguez has kept his family life private.
On social media, Tom has only shared glimpses of his son and current partner, including family photos where they are seen from behind.
On Sunday (September 13), a photo studio thanked Tom for continuing to choose them to capture his family's milestones. The post featured Tom alongside a woman, both dressed in black and white.
The identity of the woman was not mentioned, raising the question: Is she Tom's baby mama?
